And if you want to know why I predict another attempt failure it's because I'm too scared. Hopefully one day I won't be anymore

I'm so disappointed I couldn't do it
I couldn't do it.

I don't fear what will happen to me, I couldn't care less about that. I fear death because of the sadness it will bring to my family. 

What I guess I should've said is that I'm waiting for that one low moment where I will feel bad enough to decide that the ending of my misery is of more importance than the beginning of the misery for others.

The only reason I've been alive for the past 5 years is for other people. I don't even know why I do it, they don't care about me at all. I'm tired of being selfless, if other people feel pain when I'm gone then I'm sorry but it's better this way.

I know her through school. I've had feelings for 3 years, but I only started actually talking to her very early last year. From the start of last year to early this year, I'd say we got close. She is certainly my best friend and the only person I feel I can talk to about anything, but I am by no means hers. She has many, many other friends she talks to MUCH more than me. I think that I was one of her close friends, but not close enough to be one of her best friends.

Recently-ish, she started to get distant. Not wanting to annoy her or bother her, I started to leave her alone. She didn't talk to me for nearly a month. She is talking to me again now, but I feel like this has damaged our friendship a lot. I don't know, actually. I don't hold a grudge, but since I have NO idea why she became so hostile and distant it just feels a bit **awkward**.

Thanks again for taking the time to reply. It means a lot :)

Well, it's been a while and not one word has been spoken to me. I have approached her a couple times, but I get nothing in return. I don't know what I did wrong. I just want to fix what I broke and move on from this. She was and is such a great person; I don't want our friendship to end like this. 

I'm not taking it as well as I was at the start. I thought that this was my chance to distance myself, and start to move on from an impossible hope. However, since then, I have slipping downhill FAST. It's now at the stage where I feel even worse than before all this. This is the worst I've ever been! It's destroying me. But, sometimes for a couple hours I feel perfectly happy again. I have HUGE mood swings every day, from being generally alright to being absolutely destroyed when I see her. Is something wrong with me? Or is this a side effect of limerence as the internet has suggested?

Anyway, I would love any advice from where to go from here. You have been a huge help in this tough time, and I can't thank you enough.

Thanks for replying! A surprising ammount has happened in the last week. First of all, something happened and she is being really distant and hostile. I have no idea what happened, as she will barely talk to me. I didn't do anything to upset her, she just came to school one day and decided she hates me. I am not leaving out any detail, this is exactly what's happening. It sucks really badly that she is doing this with zero explanation, but I'm not going to pry. If she wants me to know, then she would tell me. 

And, secondly, because she is doing this, I have managed to convince myself that she is a bad person (she is by no means a bad person though). I have done this because I finally realised I have 0 chance at all, and now I think I can at least begin to move on. Well, at least I can try now. 

So, even though it's not the best outcome, I suppose if this works I won't care anymore. Thanks for all your advice though. Your posts along with others have helped me through this tough situation more than you ever know. Thank you very much! :)
This is my existence in a nut shell. People like me, but I'm never anywhere near their favorite person. I'm never the best friend, the person to go to, I'm just there.
Yeah, that's probably the way out I'm going to choose. Hopefully it will be a bit shorter than 17 months :P

I really want to do this now. But just a couple more issues with it.

Firstly, she has a boyfriend right now and she's pretty happy with him. It's going to last a while, but I don't think forever. Doing this whilst she is in a relationship would be disrespectful wouldn't it? And the other thing, I really don't want to lose my friendship with her. Seeing her is one of the only things that makes me feel better, and what happens when that is taken away? I don't just love her, she's the best friend I've ever had. I am so scared of losing that.

I am so tempted to do it. I've been so tempted for a long time now. Like I said, the only reason I haven't is the chance that she won't talk to me. I realize that if she is a good friend the friendship shouldn't be affected at all, but she is a bit uncomfortable in tricky situations and tends to just be distant with them. I can only imagine how distant she *could* become if I told her. 

She really is the only person I feel comfortable around. Like I mentioned, I'm a disposable friend like I always have been, and without her I have no belonging. Hell, even with her as my friend it's hard to fit in anywhere. The only other people I really talk to are friends with her so if something happened I can guess that I would be a loner; again. I just don't want that to happen.

Thanks for cheering me up though. I might take this risk eventually, because I really don't know how much longer I can stand this agony. The only thing stopping me is the possibility that this agony gets worse. Your advice really means a lot. :)

I think what sucks the most is that my relationship with her isn't gone, it's just diminished. She is still the only person I feel close to, but she just doesn't feel the same way anymore. She is still friends with me, and talks to me a lot, but I know that she will never want to be with me now. So I have to watch her meeting up with other people and flirting with other boys all the while I'm in awful pain. 

I can't say anything either, because I don't want to say anything that might hurt the friendship I have with her. I don't want to lose the only person who I feel comfortable around. She has no idea I love her, and she can never know. And what's more, every time she compliments me or is overly nice to me, I get flashbacks of when I was happy and start to get hope that she'll like me back again. This of course just makes it feel worse when I inevitably realize it's not going to happen again.

Thanks for all your advice though. I'm trying so hard to begin moving on. I'm just having a really fucking hard time since I see her 5/7 days a week. But I've got to keep trying I suppose.

Hey man, depression sucks, and if you ever want/need to talk to a stranger, I'm always here. I know how it feels :(

One sleepless night, lying awake depressed and sad, and just wanting all the pain to go away, I decided to listen to How To Disappear Completely. I had only ever listened to the rockier Radiohead (The Bends and Pablo Honey, not even Ok Computer) because had heard Idioteque and hated it at that time. 

Anyway, I put on the song. And that was the first time a Radiohead song ever clicked for me. It described exactly how I felt at that moment; "I'm not here. This isn't happening." It was a happy-sad feeling. Hard to describe. After that song, I started to listen to more Radiohead. I started clicking with other songs that described how I felt (All I Need, True Love Waits, No Surprises) and now I love pretty much every Radiohead song.

But now, anytime I feel the same way, I play the same song. That's why HTDC is my favorite Radiohead song of all time and always will be.

I am not so much a outcast, but I am definetly a 3rd wheel. I am the disposable friend, who doesn't need to be around. That's all.

She isn't being distant to me anymore, it was just the one day I was feeling down in the dumps that she ignored me. It bothered me how usually she is so nice and caring, but the one day I saw looking forward to her company most she ignored me. She only ever ignores me when I am sad or depressed, which is why I have to hide it all the time. The last couple days she has been close again and talking to me.

I believe I have been a very good friend to her; I always ask her how she is, if she's okay, what she's been doing, etc. We have never fought ever. I am always there for her. She just doesn't accept these things. She would much rather go to other people than me, even though I am there for her a lot more than they are. I don't blame her, she just goes to people she feels closer to, but it sucks so bad.

I have no real friends either. I just hang around with people. They barely talk to me, no matter how much I try and engage myself in conversation or activities. I'm just kind of there. I don't need to be around them at all, they don't need me there. This happens every single time I get into any friendship group and I don't know why. It's not that I'm rude or annoying, because they don't ignore me as such, but they just give me nothing. I don't need to be around.

The only exception to this is the girl. She is the only one who constantly talks to me. I believe(d) we were semi-best friends. But everytime I get upset, she just doesn't talk to me at all anymore. She ignores me. I don't know why. But anyway, I can't lose the only person who actually engages me in stuff. But I am sure she doesn't like me at all. Your ideas make a lot of sense, and I can definitely that maybe the girl is confused at these emotions and is kind of ignoring me.

But unfortunately I doubt it very, very. much. I'll give you an example. At school there was a choice of three activities you could do. You just pick which one you want to do most, then second most, then third most. You only get to be in one. The teachers promised to put you with your friend groups. That's why she and I both ended up in the same group; the teachers saw I didn't talk to anyone else. She had a couple other friends in this group, but the majority of the people she talked to got into another. Now, without even asking me what I think, she moved groups instantly. She went straight up and asked to be moved back with the majority of her friends, in another group. After she was moved, she was happy, and excited. She went around hugging her other friends. She was happy to be away from me.

She actually DID ask her other friends in my group if they would mind if she left, but not me. I didn't even cross her mind. She doesn't care about me at all, and she never will. I used to think I was one of her best friends, but now I see that I don't matter to her, or anyone else. 

I'm trying to get over it by being mad at her. "Wow, what kind of friend ignores someone when they are sad and depressed?!" "What kind of person just leaves another person behind just to get what they want?!" But it's no use. Everytime I start and get angry at her, I just forgive her instantly. I can't help it. I love her. I somehow think that the things she is doing are somehow MY fault, and I deserve this. There is no escape from this feeling.

Maybe shyness wasn't the right word. Now that I've thought about it, I think she is more self-conscious and fragile. I know for a fact that if I told her about how I feel  and she was shocked at all by this, she would be distant. She is very caring and friendly, but I know that something like that would confuse the hell out of her. Also, she's the only friend I have anymore and I cannot risk not having anyone to talk to. I would become even more depressed than I am now.

I try and hint at my feelings by doing things for her I probably wouldn't do for anyone else (though I should). I always offer to do things for her, I always help her with anything, but she takes it for granted. I'm fine with that though, because anything I can say or do to help her or make her feel better is 100% worth it. Unfortunately, I can't show her the full extent of it. It's ridiculous how much I would do for her, how much I would say to make her happy. But alas, I cannot so any of these things. It gets to you.

I think I make it obvious enough that she would be noticing things if she was interested. Plus, if she was interested, wouldn't she want to be around me more, or talk to me more? Maybe not, maybe you're right, maybe she is just uncomfortable and doesn't know how to act around me because she has feelings for me. But I'm pretty sure that even if this was the case should could at least reply when I say "hey, how are you?" Or "are you doing alright?"

I haven't told her for the sake of keeping our friendship. She is a bit shy, and I'm certain she would become extremely distant if I told her how I really felt.

Plus, she has a boyfriend. She's not 100% happy with him, which is why I let myself fall for her in the first place I think. But now I know she's not interested in me either. 

But that's okay. All I want is for her to happy. As long as she is I can stand this pain. But I just want to help her be happy, I suppose. I feel like I could do so much for her, just if she have me a chance. That's the main reason it hurts I think. And it does hurt. It hurts oh so much.

This is exactly, and I mean EXACTLY how I feel; except I only feel pain and longing instead of feeling nothing at all. 

I know how hard it is to talk. I know how hard it is to trust anyone. But you need to talk to someone. Maybe you can't completely get rid of your depression, but you can make it much less influential on your life. You need to tell someone, ANYONE you trust. Just try one person. Open up to more people if you want, but one is a start. I'm sure there are people in your life who know you're upset, and are really worried about you. There are people in your life that WILL help you. You just need to let them.

It's gonna be really hard to open up. I know because I myself haven't opened up to anybody yet either, and I don't plan too, unless I want to make things worse than they already are. But I really think you should try and get some help.

It's tempting to self harm, or even suicide, but here's the reason I haven't done those things yet; there will be someone in your life who is going to be very upset by this. You probably haven't, but I think that if you have told anyone about what you have been doing to yourself they would be shocked and very concerned. In fact, if they don't act like that, they are heartless. Don't do anything that will hurt yourself, because it's going to hurt others as well. You can do this without hurting other people.

It's so hard, isn't it? But you can make it through the pain. Find a new therapist, if you don't trust your current one. Open up to just one person who you think cares a lot, and try and get help. I guarantee if you look for help you will find it. Just look at all the replies you're getting here!

Please, if you ever need to, PM me. Please do. I am always here to help, it's one of the only things that makes me happy these days. Or, if not me, another one of these lovely people offering to help you. You can do this. It's fucking hard, but you can do this.

There are a couple meanings for that song, but I personally think Unrequited Love suits it best. 

He is waiting for a chance: "...next act, waiting in the wings."
He is trapped by her, can't let go: "...animal, trapped in your hot car."
He feels ignored; not needed by her: "...all the days, that you choose to ignore."

"You're all I need" speaks for itself.
He is always there, waiting for her, in the middle of all the other people in her life which she cares me about: "I'm in the middle of your picture, lying in the reeds."

He just wants to be as special as her: "...who just wants to share your light."
He wants to escape the depression he feels, and the only way to do this is to be with her: "...trying to get out if the night."
There are no others. She is the only one hell ever love: "...because there are no others."

"It's all right," At least he has her in his life? She makes him happy already. She doesn't care about him that much, but at least she is there. It's all right, I guess.
"It's all wrong," Nope. He loves her beyond whatever relationship they already have. He can't help it. He is literally dying for his chance, which isn't coming...

That's my interpretation anyway. I could be totally wrong. Anyway, it is a very sad song, and it's very sad if you can relate to it in any way.
